name: What is gas line relocation and why might I need it?

mainEntity.name: What is gas line relocation and why might I need it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gas line relocation involves moving or rerouting existing natural gas lines to a new position. This service is typically needed for home renovations, kitchen or laundry room remodels, landscaping projects that interfere with underground lines, or when installing new gas appliances that require a different gas hookup point. For example, if you're moving a gas range to a new spot in your kitchen, the gas line will need to be safely extended or rerouted to the new appliance location to ensure proper and safe operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gas line relocation moves or reroutes existing gas lines, often needed for home renovations, appliance installation, or landscaping projects.
